pick.headline: Georgian President Gamsakhurdia flees Tbilisi
pick.summary: On January 6, 1992, Georgia's President Zviad Gamsakhurdia fled Tbilisi after two weeks of fighting with armed opposition forces besieging his government building.
pick.significance: His ouster opened the way for Eduard Shevardnadze's return and years of civil conflict in Georgia. It was one of the first violent changes of power in the post-Soviet states.

alternates.headline: Manila apartment fire exposes the Bojinka plot
alternates.summary: On January 6, 1995, a chemical fire in a Manila apartment led police to bomb-making materials and a laptop belonging to Ramzi Yousef's cell, exposing plans to kill the Pope and bomb US airliners over the Pacific.
alternates.significance: The discovery foiled what became known as the Bojinka plot and led to Yousef's arrest a month later. Elements of the plan prefigured the September 11 attacks.
